rules.ed448: RFC 8032 Ed448, phflag 0, context empty: verify(public_key, intent, signature) with dom4 = SigEd448 || 0x00 || 0x00; the public key and R must decode to points other than the identity
rules.fndsa: FN-DSA-1024 (profile string above), raw message: hpk = SHAKE256(public_key, 64), mu = SHAKE256(hpk || 0x00 || 0x00 || intent, 64), c = HashToPoint(SHAKE256(signature[1..41] || mu)); public key header 0x0a, signature header 0x3a
rules.intent: intent = SHA-512(domain || 0x00 || challenge); no length prefix; payload at most 1,048,576 bytes
rules.serialization: signature = ed448 (114 bytes) || fndsa (1280 bytes) = 1394 bytes; any other length is malformed; no header, no length prefix
